reveal_en: Sharks, as a distinct group, have been swimming Earth's oceans for over 400 million years. This means they predate the first forests and even the evolution of trees on land by tens of millions of years.
reveal_zh: 鲨鱼作为独立群体，在地球海洋中畅游已超过4亿年。这意味着它们比陆地上的第一批森林和树木早了数千万年。
meaning_en: This fact profoundly shifts our perspective on deep time and the relative antiquity of life forms we consider ancient.
meaning_zh: 这深刻改变了我们对地球深层时间和古老生命形式相对久远的认知。

visual.motion: A deep, vast ocean with subtle currents and faint, ancient patterns.
